name: Reverse water-gas shift for e-fuels
principle: Reverse water-gas shift (CO2 + H2 -> CO + H2O) turns CO2 into the CO needed for syngas. Topsoe's electrified RWGS reactor ran in the FrontFuel SynFuels project in Denmark from November 2024 (12 kg/h CO2) and is planned for a 2.5 ktpa synthetic fuels plant at Leuna, Germany from 2027. IEA rates CO2-to-methanol via RWGS at TRL 6 and RWGS+FT at TRL 7.
